integrity: A full symbolic proof gives the global extrema; standalone matrix-exponential, integration and symbolic checker gives independently reproducible finite diagnostics, not a proof of unbounded parameter ranges.
scientific_limitations: Exact three-site, ideal projective measurement, exponential waiting times, active zero-overhead source re-preparation after each failed probe, fixed flux orientation and specified source/detector. No claim for passive monitoring, physical reset costs, robustness of the tie, or arbitrary graphs.
title: Exactly two optimal Poisson interrogation rates on a chiral quantum triangle
